item.title: Long Island Assemblymember Ed Ra wins GOP leadership
item.description: Assemblymember Ed Ra was unanimously elected as the new Minority Leader by state Republican lawmakers, replacing outgoing Assemblymember Will Barclay, and has pledged to focus on public safety and affordability.

item.title: Val Bialas to reopen in time for winter break
item.description: The historic Val Bialas Ski Center in Utica will be opening for the rest of the skiing season, according to Utica Mayor Mike Galime.

item.title: One dead in multi-company fire in Forestport
item.description: One person is dead after several departments were called to a large fire in the town of Forestport on Sunday night, according to Oneida County Sheriffs.

item.title: Advocates, Dems rally for prison sentencing overhaul
item.description: Advocates, activists, Democratic lawmakers, and families of incarcerated New Yorkers gathered at the State Capitol to call for passage of three criminal justice bills that would address outdated sentencing laws and give a second chance to thousands in custody at state-run prisons.

item.title: Sauquoit man arrested after near miss with New Hartford PD vehicle
item.description: A Sauquoit man is now facing several charges after nearly hitting a New Hartford Police vehicle early Monday morning.

item.title: Madison County Sheriff Todd Hood selected to run for lieutenant governor on Republican ticket
item.description: Madison County Sheriff Todd Hood has been selected by Bruce Blakeman, the likely Republican candidate for governor, to run for lieutenant governor.

item.title: Village of Poland to decide on dissolution of fire district
item.description: On Tuesday, members of the Poland Joint Fire District -- which covers several towns and villages in the area -- will vote on whether or not to keep the district going.
